data.long_meaning: From the Latin name Aevalone, meaning strong, healthful, gentle. In legend, Aevalone was a nymph who protected gardens and fields. In Christianity, the name Evelyn or Evalyn is derived from the Hebrew name Hevel, meaning breath or soul.
